# semaphore_ex_workflow_definition (Data Source)

Reads a Semaphore EX workflow definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_workflow_definition" "release" {
  project_id = 1
  id         = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
